sources.search_query: New Zealand official immigration NZeTA electronic travel authority visitor visa waiver countries
sources.relevant_excerpt: Complete visa waiver list: Andorra, Argentina, Austria, Bahrain, Belgium, Brazil, Brunei, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia (citizens only), Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hong Kong, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, South Korea, Kuwait, Latvia (citizens only), Liechtenstein, Lithuania (citizens only), Luxembourg, Macau, Malaysia, Malta, Mauritius, Mexico, Monaco, Netherlands, Norway, Oman, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, San Marino, Saudi Arabia, Seychelles, Singapore, Slovak Republic, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States of America, Uruguay, and Vatican City. Visitors from visa waiver countries do not need a visitor visa to enter New Zealand for a period of less than 3 months, or 6 months if from the United Kingdom. NZeTA required. Australian citizens and permanent residents travelling on an Australian passport do not need a visa or an NZeTA.

sources.search_query: New Zealand official immigration NZeTA electronic travel authority visitor visa waiver countries
sources.relevant_excerpt: You may obtain an NZeTA if you are a citizen of a visa waiver country or territory, a citizen of China or a Pacific Islands Forum country travelling from Australia with an eligible Australian visa, a cruise or cargo ship passenger, an Australian permanent resident, or transiting through New Zealand. Maximum stay: up to 3 months at a time, or up to 6 months at a time if you are from the United Kingdom. Transit passengers: up to 24 hours at Auckland International Airport only. You can only be in New Zealand for up to 6 months within any 12-month period. Cost: From NZD $17. Valid for 2 years for travellers (5 years for airline crew). Allow 72 hours. Official application portal: https://nzeta.immigration.govt.nz/

sources.search_query: immigration.govt.nz visa waiver countries list visitor visa
sources.relevant_excerpt: Most people travelling to New Zealand need to get either a visa, or a New Zealand Electronic Travel Authority (NZeTA). Which one you need depends on your passport and situation. Use Immigration New Zealand's online tool to find out what you need. Passport holders from visa waiver countries can use the NZeTA system; others require a visitor visa.

sources.search_query: immigration.govt.nz visa waiver countries list visitor visa
sources.relevant_excerpt: People travelling on a passport from some countries must apply for a Visitor Visa to visit New Zealand. Maximum stay: up to either 6 months or 9 months depending on visa type; multiple-entry visas permit stays of up to 6 months per 12-month period, single-entry up to 9 months within an 18-month period. Application fee starts at NZD $441. Apply online through https://apply.immigration.govt.nz/ or complete the Visitor Visa Application (INZ 1017) paper form. Your passport or certificate of identity must be valid for at least 3 months after the date you plan to leave New Zealand.

sources.search_query: immigration.govt.nz International Visitor Conservation and Tourism Levy IVL amount NZD NZeTA cost
sources.relevant_excerpt: International Visitor Conservation and Tourism Levy (IVL) amount: NZD $100. The IVL applies to most people applying for visitor visas, NZeTAs, student visas, working holiday schemes, and specific work visas. Exemptions exist for Australian and New Zealand passport holders, certain Pacific Island nation citizens, transit passengers, resident visa holders, and Business Visitor Visa holders. You pay it when you request an NZeTA, or apply for your visa. We do not refund the IVL, even if we decline your application.
